card.title: How Much Do You Know?
card.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm family. Why am I getting the public version of what happened to the wedding cake?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Someone dropped it off the balcony.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Does the family version include a name?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me where you were.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You want my alibi before giving me family gossip? That's the police version.

bespokePairs.seedUse: Uses S124-single-a's family-versus-public access distinction and D06-single-a's inquiry about the party, cake and balcony, adapted here to a wedding. A1 challenges the public account, A3 asks for a name after B2 supplies the balcony, and A5 treats B4's demand for an alibi as the wrong access terms without supplying it. Both this pair and the revised Drive seed now give B the balcony detail. The earlier contrast with A's disclosure described the historical 0.25.0 Drive seed. Pair dialogue and its completed review evidence are unchanged.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why is my report on the missing keys censored? I'm on this committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's for the inner committee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can an outer member at least know where they were found?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The location starts with 'under'. That's all you get.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What would I have to chair to earn the next word?

bespokePairs.seedUse: Adapts S124-single-b's restricted club briefing and committee membership as a test of belonging to this pair's inner/outer committee report; D06-single-b supplies the missing-key inquiry. A1 challenges censorship, A3 asks for location after B2 excludes A, and A5 uses B4's partial location to ask what chair role earns more information. The revised Drive seed gives B the drain detail; the pair never mentions a drain. The former 'no longer leaks' contrast concerned the historical 0.25.0 Drive seed. Pair dialogue and completed review evidence are unchanged.

card.title: Cleared to Know
card.instruction: Treat access to private information as proof that you belong, and exclusion from any detail as a challenge to your legitimacy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pass me the unredacted reunion plan. I'm family, not the public.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That page lists everyone's surprise presents.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Family should get more than the visitor edition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It includes your present.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell me who chose it. I should know who considers me family.

card.title: How Much Do You Know?
card.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When you say you heard about the party, which part?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bit with the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before or after it reached the balcony?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What happened on the balcony?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nothing confirmed. Who's been using that word?

card.title: Cleared to Know
card.instruction: Treat access to private information as proof that you belong, and exclusion from any detail as a challenge to your legitimacy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why does my club briefing have blacked-out names?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only the organising committee sees those.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I stacked every chair for that committee. Surely I've earned the names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can apply next month. I'll sponsor you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Could you put one name in my copy now, so I know you're sponsoring a member?

card.title: How Much Do You Know?
card.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What did the manager say about the missing keys?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That they're missing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No mention of a drain, then?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Should there be?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm checking how thorough the briefing was.

card.title: How Much Do You Know?
card.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When you say you heard about the party, which part?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake went over the balcony. Was that before you left?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Who gave you the timing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody. Your brother says there's a video.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Have you watched it, or are we both relying on my brother?

card.title: How Much Do You Know?
card.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What did the manager say about the missing keys?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They might be in the drain. You locked up, didn't you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Is she asking everyone who locked up, or just me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just you. Someone saw you outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did they say what I was doing, or only where I was?
